description: Header file defining the HttpStreamParser class for parsing HTTP streams, including methods for sending requests, reading responses, handling connection reuse, and encoding chunks. It is part of the net namespace and includes various internal states and buffers.

classes.name: HttpStreamParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing HTTP streams, managing request/response lifecycle, connection reuse, and chunk encoding.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified request line, headers, and traffic annotation; prepares response object.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads the response headers from the stream.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body into provided buffer.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully received.

methods.name: CanFindEndOfResponse
methods.description: Determines if the end of the response can be identified.

methods.name: IsMoreDataBuffered
methods.description: Checks if more data is buffered.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Determines if the current connection can be reused.

methods.name: OnConnectionClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the connection is closed.

methods.name: EncodeChunk
methods.description: Encodes payload into chunked transfer format.

methods.name: ShouldMergeRequestHeadersAndBody
methods.description: Determines if request headers and body should be merged.
